posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I've moved this thread to MZ Support (from Product Discussion & Support). Thank you.
I've assumed you're using MZ because that is in your profile's "Primarily Uses" field. If not, just let me know~
If you can't turn or open the pause menu, then check for Autorun events.
If you can turn but not move to another tile, try holding Ctrl (i.e. ignore collisions in playtest). If that lets you move, then it is a passability problem. I suggest sharing screenshots of:
The tileset's passage settings in the database, and
The map where you get stuck.
If you're using any plugins, you could also turn those off, save your project, and test to see if that helps.
